text:
emma-cs: Hi team, enterprise customer 'AcmeCorp' reporting 403 on /v1/rerank for batch requests only. Embeddings and generate endpoints work. Started after their SSO sync earlier today. Repro steps attached.

jordan-eng: Thanks — can you share a redacted request + headers? Also which SDK/version?

emma-cs: Using our backend -> api gateway -> redwood. SDK is our JS client v1.4.2. Here's the curl they ran (token redacted):

emma-cs: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
 -H "X-Forwarded-Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
 -d '{"model":"rerank-1","queries":["q1","q2"],"documents":[...]} ' 
```

lee-infra: hm the duplicate header stands out. Our auth parser picks the first Authorization header and ignores duplicates, but the gateway has a passthrough that can merge headers in some configs. Any raw ingress logs?

ops-bot: access.log: tenant=acmecorp route=/v1/rerank method=POST status=403 auth_claims="{\"entitlements\":{\"embeddings\":true,\"generate\":true,\"rerank\":false}}" src=10.10.5.23

jordan-eng: Wait auth_claims show rerank=false despite the org entitlement including rerank in the IDP. Could be a header mangling or whitespace/newline issue during header concatenation.

emma-cs: Customer confirms they migrated an NGINX sidecar which adds X-Forwarded-Authorization. They didn't know both headers would be present.

lee-infra: Reproduced locally with two auth headers. Our token normalization code splits on commas and newlines when multiple headers are present; if the second header ends with a \n or null char it can corrupt base64 padding of the JWT -> signature check falls back and we issue a limited-claims token (rerank dropped).

sam-prod: Can you paste the decoded claims from the failing log?

ops-bot: decoded_claims.log: {"sub":"svc-acme-123","entitlements":{"generate":true,"embeddings":true},"iss":"sso.acme"}  <-- rerank missing

jordan-eng: Repro steps for infra to validate: 1) curl with 2 auth headers identical 2) add trailing newline in second header 3) hit /v1/rerank batch 4) observe 403 and claims missing rerank.

lee-infra: Confirmed. Patch proposed: normalize headers by preferring the first Authorization header and discarding duplicates at gateway layer; also trim trailing whitespace and nulls before JWT parse. PR #1234.

emma-cs: Customer impact: only rerank fails (403) — fallback to single-doc generate/rerank workaround recommended. Customer ok with patch ETA.

jordan-eng: Will add a temporary mitigation in the auth layer to accept rerank if token issuer matches and other entitlements present (conservative). Need sign-off from security.

sam-prod: Noted. I'll coordinate with customer for rolling restart of their sidecar if they prefer.

lee-infra: Rolling hotfix deployment scheduled: canary to 10% in us-west at 1766543600, full rollout by 1766547200 if metrics look good.

emma-cs: Thanks — logging this as ESCL-2026-112 and sending customer the workaround + timeline.

jordan-eng: Add unit tests covering duplicate headers + newline edgecase. Also add a synthetic monitor hitting /v1/rerank with malformed header to ensure regression caught.

lee-infra: PR linked: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/platform/pulls/1234. ops runbook updated.

emma-cs: customer updated that workaround works. Closing once patch is live. :white_check_mark:
